title: Read a protected file
shortDescription: Observe the permission denied error when reading a 000-permission file.
descriptionMd:
## Permission denied

A file with permissions `000` cannot be read by anyone. Attempting `cat` on it shows the error. Understanding errors is part of learning.
goalMd: Run `cat protected.txt` — observe the Permission denied error.

hints.textMd: Just run `cat protected.txt` and observe the output.
